pages.educators.heroTitle.back: Run a Thinkerwell lesson with your group

pages.educators.heroBody.back: Use Thinkerwell's free social studies lessons with your group. Teach on one shared screen, in pairs, or on separate devices, or print the lessons. Learners don't need to make accounts.
pages.educators.heroBody.note: Public copy update (October 2026, from Justin's copy guide): drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.educators.previewLesson.note: Used 'Pratinjau' (standard software term) for preview throughout the teacher pages. Simpler alternative: 'Coba lihat pelajaran'.

pages.educators.printLesson.back: See the print version of the lesson

pages.educators.needTitle.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.educators.need1.source: One device for every 1 to 3 learners, or one big screen
pages.educators.need1.back: One device for every 1 to 3 learners, or one big screen

pages.educators.need2.back: Paper and pencils for making plans

pages.educators.need4.source: Internet for the first visit, and for videos
pages.educators.need4.back: Internet for the first visit and for videos

pages.educators.step1Body.source: Lessons can go in any order. Choose one that fits your group, or follow the numbers.
pages.educators.step1Body.back: Lessons can be taken in any order. Choose one that suits your group, or follow the numbers.
pages.educators.step1Body.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.educators.step2Body.source: Read, Write, Speak, Watch, Reflect. Pair learners for Speak. Watch can be skipped.
pages.educators.step2Body.back: Read, Write, Speak, Watch, Reflect. Pair learners up for Speak. Watch may be skipped.

pages.educators.step3Body.source: Ask two or three learners to share their answer. Everyone writes one reflection.
pages.educators.step3Body.back: Ask two or three learners to share their answer. Everyone writes one reflection.

pages.educators.previewIntro.source: Every lesson has a teacher guide with a session plan and the answers, and every section check has an answer key.
pages.educators.previewIntro.back: Every lesson has a teacher guide containing a session plan and its answers, and every section check has an answer key.

pages.educators.answerKeyLabel.source: Answer key for the {section} section check

pages.educators.codesTag.note: 'Pilot' translated as 'uji coba' (here and in codesBody). Alternative: 'program percontohan'.

pages.educators.codesBody.source: In the pilot, each learner can get a code like HLP-07. Later, codes will let us see how the whole group is doing, without any names. You keep the list that matches names to codes.
pages.educators.codesBody.back: During the pilot, each learner can get a code like HLP-07. Later, these codes will help us see the whole group's progress without anyone's name. You keep the list pairing names and codes.
pages.educators.codesBody.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.educators.feedbackBody.source: Something confusing, too difficult or broken? Tell us at {email}. Don't send learners' names or written answers.
pages.educators.feedbackBody.back: Something confusing, too difficult or broken? Tell us at {email}. Don't send learners' names or their written answers.
pages.educators.feedbackBody.note: Public copy update (October 2026, from Justin's copy guide): drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.educators.toolsIntro.source: For the day you start, and every day after. Everything here stays on this device.
pages.educators.toolsIntro.back: For the first day you start, and every day after. Everything here stays on this device.
pages.educators.toolsIntro.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.educators.setupBody.source: A checklist for each laptop or tablet. Print it to tick on paper.
pages.educators.setupBody.back: A checklist for every laptop or tablet. Print it to tick off on paper.

pages.educators.classBody.source: Lessons finished and where each learner is now. No scores.
pages.educators.classBody.back: Lessons already finished and where each learner is now. No scores.

pages.educators.certificatesBody.source: Every certificate earned on this device, one to a page.
pages.educators.certificatesBody.back: All certificates earned on this device, one per page.

pages.teacherTools.why.note: Translator note says the explanation after it is in English; in the Indonesian build it will be Indonesian. 'Alasannya:'.

pages.teacherGuide.intro.source: Everything you need to teach this lesson, with the answers. It prints on A4, black on white, without the menus.
pages.teacherGuide.intro.back: Everything you need to teach this lesson, complete with the answers. It can be printed on A4 paper, black on white, without menus.
pages.teacherGuide.intro.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.teacherGuide.essentialQuestion.note: 'Pertanyaan utama'. Alternative: 'Pertanyaan pokok' or 'Pertanyaan esensial' (curriculum term).

pages.teacherGuide.contentNotePointer.source: The video has a content note. Read it before class: it is with the video, below.
pages.teacherGuide.contentNotePointer.back: This video has a content note. Read it before class: the note is with the video, below.

pages.teacherGuide.planIntro.source: A suggested plan for a session of about 45 minutes. Change it to suit your group.
pages.teacherGuide.planIntro.back: A suggested plan for a session of about 45 minutes. Change it to suit your group.
pages.teacherGuide.planIntro.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.teacherGuide.planDoTitle.note: Reviewer: Minor: 'Yang dilakukan' = 'what is done'; English is 'What to do' (instructions). 'Yang perlu dilakukan' may read more naturally as a column heading.

pages.teacherGuide.planColumn.note: Table heading asked to be very short, so 'mnt' abbreviation. Same abbreviation used in planShorter ('kolom 30 mnt'). Use 'menit' if space allows.

pages.teacherGuide.planShorter.source: Only 30 minutes? Use the 30 min column: skip Watch or read instead, and take a little time off the other steps. Learners can open Watch later, because nothing is locked.
pages.teacherGuide.planShorter.back: Only have 30 minutes? Use the 30 min column: skip Watch or use Just read, and cut a little time from the other steps. Learners can open Watch later, because nothing is locked.

pages.teacherGuide.planDo.warmUp.source: Ask the warm-up question. Every answer is fine: it gets everyone thinking.
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.warmUp.back: Ask the warm-up question. All answers are allowed: the aim is so that everyone starts thinking.

pages.teacherGuide.planDo.read.note: Every lesson has 3 parts, so one form is fine. 'Standard or Simpler English' rendered as 'versi Standar atau Lebih mudah' to match the reading-level toggle (the text is not English in Indonesian).
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.read.source: Read the {count} parts one at a time, in Standard or Simpler English. Look at the evidence and the picture together.
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.read.back: Read the {count} parts of the text one at a time, in the Standard or Easier version. Look at the evidence and pictures together.

pages.teacherGuide.planDo.check.source: Learners answer the {count} quick-check questions, then talk about the answers.
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.check.back: Learners answer the {count} quick-check questions, then discuss the answers together.

pages.teacherGuide.planDo.write.source: Learners plan and write their answer, then tick the self-check. Sentence starters help.
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.write.back: Learners make a plan and write their answer, then tick the self-check. Sentence starters can help.

pages.teacherGuide.planDo.speak.source: Learners tell a partner their answer, or practise on their own.
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.speak.back: Learners tell their answer to a friend, or practise alone.

pages.teacherGuide.planDo.watch.source: Watch the video together, or read the written version instead.
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.watch.back: Watch the video together, or read its written version.

pages.teacherGuide.planDo.reflect.source: Everyone answers the first reflect question. It finishes the lesson.
pages.teacherGuide.planDo.reflect.back: Everyone answers the first reflection question. Answering it will finish the lesson.

pages.teacherGuide.checkIntro.source: Learners see the options in a different order, and can try again as often as they like.
pages.teacherGuide.checkIntro.back: Learners see the answer options in a different order, and can try again as often as they want.

pages.teacherGuide.think.note: 'Think question' as 'Pertanyaan untuk dipikirkan'; 'no single right answer' as 'jawaban yang benar bisa lebih dari satu', matching the learner screen. Same for thinkOptional. | Reviewer: Meaning shift: English 'there is no single right answer' (open question); Indonesian says 'the right answer can be more than one', which still implies some answers are right and others wrong. Consider 'tidak ada satu jawaban yang paling benar'.
pages.teacherGuide.think.source: Think question: there is no single right answer.
pages.teacherGuide.think.back: A question to think about: there can be more than one right answer.

pages.teacherGuide.thinkOptional.source: Think question, optional: there is no single right answer.
pages.teacherGuide.thinkOptional.back: A question to think about, not required: there can be more than one right answer.
pages.teacherGuide.thinkOptional.note: Reviewer: Same as 'think': 'jawaban yang benar bisa lebih dari satu' is not quite 'no single right answer'. Keep both the same wording.

pages.teacherGuide.selfCheck.note: 'Self-check' as 'Cek mandiri' (also in planDo.write). Learners see this box titled 'Periksa jawabanmu'; the English also uses a different word, so kept distinct.

pages.teacherGuide.exampleNote.source: One way to answer. Learners' answers can be different.
pages.teacherGuide.exampleNote.back: This is one way to answer. Learners' answers may differ.

pages.teacherGuide.discussIntro.note: 'Let anyone pass' read as 'anyone may skip their turn' -> 'Siapa pun boleh melewatkan gilirannya'.
pages.teacherGuide.discussIntro.source: Questions from the lesson to talk about together. Let anyone pass.
pages.teacherGuide.discussIntro.back: Questions from the lesson to discuss together. Anyone may skip their turn.

pages.teacherGuide.reflectRequired.source: Learners answer this one to finish the lesson.
pages.teacherGuide.reflectRequired.back: Learners answer this question to finish the lesson.

pages.teacherGuide.videoOffline.source: The video needs the internet. The written version (Read instead) works offline and has the same ideas.
pages.teacherGuide.videoOffline.back: This video needs internet. Its written version (Just read) can be opened without internet and contains the same ideas.

pages.teacherGuide.afterVideo.source: After the video or the reading

pages.teacherGuide.contentNote.note: 'Content note' (warning about sensitive content) as 'Catatan isi'. Alternatives: 'Catatan konten', 'Peringatan isi'. Also in contentNotePointer.

pages.answerKey.intro.source: Every question in this section check, with the answers. It prints on A4, black on white, without the menus.
pages.answerKey.intro.back: All the questions in this section check, complete with their answers. Can be printed on A4 paper, black on white, without menus.

pages.answerKey.practice.source: The section check is for practice. It never blocks learners: there is no time limit, they can try again as often as they like, and every lesson stays open whatever their score.
pages.answerKey.practice.back: This section check is for practice. This check never blocks learners: there is no time limit, they can try again as often as they want, and all lessons stay open whatever the score.

pages.answerKey.order.source: Learners see the options in a different order, so talk about the answer itself, not where it sits.
pages.answerKey.order.back: Learners see the answer options in a different order, so discuss the content of the answer, not its position.

pages.setup.title.note: 'Siapkan perangkat ini'. The same English appears as pages.educators.setupTitle (another worklist) and is quoted in paperIntro; all three should match.

pages.setup.intro.source: Do these steps once on each laptop or tablet. Each step says whether it's done on this device.
pages.setup.intro.back: Do these steps once on every laptop or tablet. Each step shows whether it is already done on this device.

pages.setup.paperIntro.source: On each device, open Thinkerwell, then For educators, then Set up this device. Tick each step when it's done.
pages.setup.paperIntro.back: On each device, open Thinkerwell, then For educators, then Set up this device. Tick each step that is done.

pages.setup.homeScreen.title.source: Add Thinkerwell to the home screen
pages.setup.homeScreen.title.back: Add Thinkerwell to the home screen

pages.setup.homeScreen.why.source: Then it opens like an app. On iPad and iPhone, this also stops Safari deleting saved work after {count} days without a visit.
pages.setup.homeScreen.why.back: After that, Thinkerwell opens like an app. On iPad and iPhone, this also stops Safari from deleting saved work if Thinkerwell isn't opened for {count} days.

pages.setup.homeScreen.first.source: Do this first. Then open Thinkerwell from the home screen, and do the other steps there.
pages.setup.homeScreen.first.back: Do this first. Then open Thinkerwell from the home screen, and do the other steps there.

pages.setup.homeScreen.installed.source: Thinkerwell is open from the home screen.
pages.setup.homeScreen.installed.back: Thinkerwell is being opened from the home screen.
pages.setup.homeScreen.installed.note: Reviewer: 'sedang dibuka' can read as 'is being opened (right now)'. English is a status: 'is open from the home screen'. Consider 'Thinkerwell terbuka dari layar utama.'

pages.setup.homeScreen.inBrowser.source: Thinkerwell is open in the browser. If you've added it already, open it from the home screen instead.
pages.setup.homeScreen.inBrowser.back: Thinkerwell is open in the browser. If you have already added it, just open it from the home screen.
pages.setup.homeScreen.inBrowser.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed. Reviewer: Same as 'installed': 'sedang dibuka di browser' reads as an action in progress. Consider 'Thinkerwell terbuka di browser.'

pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step2.note: Safari's Indonesian labels assumed: 'Bagikan'. Check on an iPad set to Indonesian.
pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step2.source: Tap Share: the square with an arrow pointing up.
pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step2.back: Tap Share: the box with an arrow pointing up.

pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step3.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed. Safari's Indonesian label assumed: 'Tambah ke Layar Utama' (and 'Tambah' in step4). Check on an iPad set to Indonesian.
pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step3.source: Tap Add to Home Screen. You may need to scroll down to find it.
pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step3.back: Tap Add to Home Screen. You may need to scroll down to find it.

pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step5.source: Open Thinkerwell from its icon. It keeps its own saved work, apart from Safari, so add learners there.
pages.setup.homeScreen.apple.step5.back: Open Thinkerwell from its icon. Work saved there is separate from Safari, so add learners there.

pages.setup.homeScreen.android.step2.source: Tap the menu: the three dots at the top.
pages.setup.homeScreen.android.step2.back: Tap the menu: three dots at the top.

pages.setup.homeScreen.android.step3.note: Chrome Android Indonesian labels assumed: 'Tambahkan ke layar utama', 'Instal aplikasi' (and 'Instal', 'Tambahkan' in step4). Check on a device.
pages.setup.homeScreen.android.step3.source: Tap Add to home screen, or Install app.
pages.setup.homeScreen.android.step3.back: Tap Add to home screen, or Install app.

pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.name.source: Windows laptop or Chromebook (Chrome or Edge)
pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.name.back: Windows laptop or Chromebook (Chrome or Edge)

pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.step1.source: Open Thinkerwell in Chrome or Edge.
pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.step1.back: Open Thinkerwell in Chrome or Edge.

pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.step2.source: Click the install button at the end of the address bar. If there isn't one, open the menu: the three dots.
pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.step2.back: Click the install button at the end of the address bar. If there isn't one, open the menu: three dots.

pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.step3.note: Chrome desktop Indonesian labels assumed: 'Instal Thinkerwell', 'Transmisikan, simpan, dan bagikan', 'Aplikasi'. Check on a laptop set to Indonesian. | Reviewer: Check that 'Transmisikan, simpan, dan bagikan' and 'Aplikasi' match the exact labels in Indonesian Chrome/Edge menus; the same for 'Tambahkan ke layar utama' / 'Instal aplikasi' (Android) and 'Tambah ke Layar Utama' (iPad).
pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.step3.source: Choose Install Thinkerwell. In the menu it may be under Cast, save and share, or under Apps.
pages.setup.homeScreen.desktop.step3.back: Choose Install Thinkerwell. In the menu, this option may be under Cast, save, and share, or under Apps.

pages.setup.offline.title.source: Download the course for offline use
pages.setup.offline.title.back: Download the course for use without internet

pages.setup.offline.why.source: Then every lesson works without the internet. Only the videos need it.
pages.setup.offline.why.back: After that, all lessons can be used without internet. Only videos need internet.

pages.setup.offline.how.source: Open Thinkerwell with the internet on, and keep it open until the lessons are saved. It does this by itself.
pages.setup.offline.how.back: Open Thinkerwell while the internet is on, and leave it open until all lessons are saved. Thinkerwell does it by itself.

pages.setup.storage.why.source: Otherwise the browser may delete learners' work when the device is low on space.
pages.setup.storage.why.back: Otherwise, the browser can delete learners' work when the device's storage space is almost full.

pages.setup.storage.how.note: 'Allow' = browser prompt 'Izinkan'. Button name 'Keep work safe' translated as 'Amankan hasil kerja' (matches pages.setup.storage.button).
pages.setup.storage.how.source: Tap Keep work safe. If the browser asks, choose Allow.
pages.setup.storage.how.back: Tap Secure work. If the browser asks, choose Allow.

pages.setup.storage.checking.source: Checking what the browser does with saved work…
pages.setup.storage.checking.back: Checking what the browser does with saved work…

pages.setup.storage.done.source: The browser keeps saved work on this device, even when space runs low.
pages.setup.storage.done.back: The browser keeps work on this device, even when storage space is almost full.

pages.setup.storage.todo.source: The browser may delete saved work when space runs low.
pages.setup.storage.todo.back: The browser can delete saved work when storage space is almost full.

pages.setup.storage.refused.source: The browser said no for now. Browsers often agree once Thinkerwell is on the home screen and used for a few days. Try again then.
pages.setup.storage.refused.back: For now the browser hasn't allowed it. Usually the browser will allow it after Thinkerwell is on the home screen and has been used for a few days. Try again later.

pages.setup.storage.unsupported.source: This browser can't be asked. Adding Thinkerwell to the home screen helps keep work safe.
pages.setup.storage.unsupported.back: This browser can't be asked. Adding Thinkerwell to the home screen helps keep work safe.

pages.setup.storage.noStorage.note: 'private window' = 'jendela pribadi (penyamaran)': Safari says 'Pribadi', Chrome says 'Penyamaran'. Same in pages.settings.offline.unsupported.
pages.setup.storage.noStorage.source: This browser window can't save learners' work at all. A private window can cause this. Open Thinkerwell in a normal window.
pages.setup.storage.noStorage.back: This browser window can't save learners' work at all. This can happen in a private (incognito) window. Open Thinkerwell in a normal window.

pages.setup.learners.title.source: Add the learners who use this device
pages.setup.learners.title.back: Add the learners who use this device

pages.setup.learners.why.source: Each learner gets a tile on the home page, and their work is kept apart.
pages.setup.learners.why.back: Each learner gets one box on the home page, and their work is saved separately.

pages.setup.learners.how.source: Tap Add a learner, or let each learner tap I'm new here on the home page.
pages.setup.learners.how.back: Tap Add learner, or let each learner tap I'm new here on the home page.

pages.setup.learners.count.back: There are {count} learners on this device.

pages.setup.learners.none.source: No learners on this device yet.
pages.setup.learners.none.back: There are no learners on this device yet.

pages.setup.speech.title.note: 'speech to text' = 'suara ke teks' (used in speech.title, sayIt.title, sayIt.download, allowOnline); 'turn speech into text' = 'mengubah ucapan menjadi teks'. Not in KEY_TERMS.

pages.setup.speech.why.source: Say it lets learners talk instead of typing. The check tells lessons whether it can work here.
pages.setup.speech.why.back: With Say it, learners can speak instead of typing. This check tells the lessons whether Say it can be used here.

pages.setup.speech.last.source: Do this step last. On some tablets the check has closed the browser tab. If that happens, open Thinkerwell again.
pages.setup.speech.last.back: Do this step last. On some tablets, this check has made the browser tab close. If that happens, open Thinkerwell again.

pages.setup.speech.how.source: In Settings, under Say it, tap Check this device.
pages.setup.speech.how.back: In Settings, in the Say it section, tap Check this device.

pages.setup.speech.notChecked.source: Not checked on this device yet.
pages.setup.speech.notChecked.back: Not yet checked on this device.

pages.setup.speech.onDevice.source: Speech to text works on this device, and what learners say is not sent anywhere.
pages.setup.speech.onDevice.back: The voice-to-text feature can be used on this device, and learners' speech isn't sent anywhere.

pages.setup.speech.download.source: It needs a one-time download first. In Settings, tap Download speech to text on good Wi-Fi, then check again.
pages.setup.speech.download.back: This feature needs to be downloaded once first. In Settings, tap Download voice-to-text feature when the Wi-Fi is good, then check again.

pages.setup.speech.notOnDevice.source: This browser can't do it on the device, so Say it stays hidden. Learners type instead.
pages.setup.speech.notOnDevice.back: This browser can't do it on the device, so Say it stays hidden. Learners just type.

pages.setup.speech.none.source: This browser can't turn speech into text, so there's nothing to check. Say it stays hidden, and learners type instead.
pages.setup.speech.none.back: This browser can't turn speech into text, so there is nothing to check. Say it stays hidden, and learners just type.

pages.setup.later.title.source: Before you reset this device or give it back
pages.setup.later.title.back: Before you reset this device or give it back
pages.setup.later.title.note: Changed from "kamu" to "Anda" (September 2026): pages for adults (educators, partners, parents) use "Anda"; pages for learners keep "kamu". Drafted by AI, not yet reviewed.

pages.setup.later.body.source: Save everyone's work to a file, then load the file on the next device. Recordings aren't in the file. Keep the file safe: anyone with it can read the work.
pages.setup.later.body.back: Save all learners' work to a file, then load that file on the next device. Recordings don't go into the file. Keep that file carefully: anyone who holds it can read the work inside.

pages.setup.later.open.source: Save work to a file in Settings
pages.setup.later.open.back: Save work to a file in Settings

pages.classView.intro.source: Every learner on this device, by name, and what each one has done.
pages.classView.intro.back: All the learners on this device, with their names, and what each one has done.

pages.classView.noScores.source: There are no scores here, because anyone using this device can open this page.
pages.classView.noScores.back: There are no scores here, because anyone who uses this device can open this page.

pages.classView.onNow.note: Label above the lesson a learner is on (or up next). 'Sekarang' is short; alternative 'Posisi sekarang'.

pages.classView.never.note: Value for 'Last active' when never active: 'Belum pernah' (literally 'never yet'), rather than a word-for-word 'Belum'.

pages.classView.empty.source: No learners on this device yet.
pages.classView.empty.back: There are no learners on this device yet.

pages.classView.emptyBody.source: Learners show up here once they're added. Each learner can add themselves with I'm new here on the home page.
pages.classView.emptyBody.back: Learners appear here after they are added. Each learner can add themselves via I'm new here on the home page.

pages.classView.noStorage.note: Added '(mode penyamaran)', the name Chrome uses in Indonesian for a private window, so staff recognise it. Remove if unwanted.
pages.classView.noStorage.source: This browser window can't keep learners' work, so there's nothing to show here. A private window can cause this.
pages.classView.noStorage.back: This browser window can't save learners' work, so there is nothing that can be shown here. A private window (incognito mode) could be the cause.

pages.allCertificates.count.source: {count} certificates earned on this device. Each prints on a landscape page of its own.
pages.allCertificates.count.back: {count} certificates earned on this device. Each certificate is printed on its own landscape page.

pages.allCertificates.names.source: Names come from this device and can't be changed here. To print a different name, choose that learner, then open their certificate from the course page.
pages.allCertificates.names.back: Names are taken from this device and can't be changed here. To print a different name, choose that learner, then open their certificate from the course page.

pages.allCertificates.empty.source: Nobody on this device has a certificate yet.
pages.allCertificates.empty.back: Nobody has a certificate on this device yet.

pages.allCertificates.emptyBody.note: 'The section check isn't needed' as 'Cek bagian tidak diperlukan untuk itu' (not needed to get a certificate).
pages.allCertificates.emptyBody.source: A learner gets one by finishing every lesson in a section. The section check isn't needed.
pages.allCertificates.emptyBody.back: Learners get a certificate by finishing all the lessons in one section. The section check isn't needed for that.

pages.settings.title.note: Changed from 'Pengaturan' to 'Pengaturan perangkat ini' to follow the new English. pages.educators.settingsLink ('Settings for this device', other worklist) should match. The nav item stays 'Pengaturan'.

pages.settings.intro.source: These settings are for teachers and volunteers. They apply to everyone who uses this device, and they stay on it.
pages.settings.intro.back: These settings are for teachers and volunteers. These settings apply to everyone who uses this device, and stay saved on this device.

pages.settings.noStorage.source: This browser window can't save settings.
pages.settings.noStorage.back: This browser window can't save settings.

pages.settings.saveFailed.source: That change couldn't be saved. Try again.
pages.settings.saveFailed.back: That change hasn't been saved yet. Try again.

pages.about.missionBody.source: Thinkerwell began with a love of social studies and a question: how can more youth have the chance to explore the world they live in? We built a free digital platform to make digital learning tools and social studies education accessible to youth facing barriers to education. Our goal is to help learners ask questions, grow their critical thinking skills, explore diverse perspectives, and share their own ideas.
pages.about.missionBody.back: Thinkerwell started from a love of social studies and a question: how can more teenagers get the chance to explore the world where they live? We built a free digital platform so that digital learning tools and social studies education can be accessed by teenagers who face obstacles in education. Our goal is to help learners ask questions, develop critical thinking skills, explore different points of view, and share their own ideas.
